key_insight: CompMat-Bench benchmarks AI agents on real computational materials research steps by precomputing simulations and grading agents with fixed rules, avoiding expensive reruns.
engineering_relevance: This gives materials researchers a practical way to compare agent workflows, pinpoint failure modes, and assess whether an AI can reliably assist with simulation setup and result analysis.
method: Built 94 tasks from recent computational materials papers
Pre-reproduced simulation inputs and outputs as ground truth for rule-based scoring
Tested single tasks and multi-step workflows under full or reduced guidance
evidence_signal: Across 94 tasks, agents based on three LLMs achieved 66.0%–90.4% pass rates on single tasks with full guidance, while longer workflows and reduced guidance reduced performance.
watch_item: Because the benchmark avoids running the underlying simulations, it measures preparation and analysis quality rather than end-to-end scientific correctness under real execution conditions.
paper_title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
